content.text: Edgewonk has been the go-to trading journal for serious traders for years. But in 2025, futures traders running prop firm evaluations need something different: native support for evaluation accounts, automatic consistency rule tracking, real-time risk alerts, and pricing that doesn't require $169 upfront. This comparison covers both tools honestly — including where Edgewonk still wins.
Quick Comparison: Zentrade vs Edgewonk

rows: CME Futures (NQ, ES, GC, CL, MNQ)

content.text: Bottom line: If you're a futures trader in a prop firm evaluation, Zentrade is built specifically for you. If you're a multi-market advanced trader who's already mastered Edgewonk and wants the deepest statistical analysis available, Edgewonk remains strong — though more expensive and without native evaluation account support.
Pricing: Upfront vs. Subscription
Edgewonk Pricing

Edgewonk's main pricing is $169/year (annual upfront). There's also a monthly option at approximately $39/month. For a trader in evaluation who doesn't know if they'll be using a paid tool for the next 6 months, a $169 commitment can be a barrier. There's no free plan — only a limited trial.
Zentrade Pricing

Zentrade has a genuinely functional free plan: 1 account, manual trade entry, basic dashboard, trade calendar, and CSV export. Paid plans start at $9/month (Starter, 2 accounts) up to $59/month (ZenMode with AI analysis and risk alerts). For an active evaluation trader, the Professional plan at $29/month covers everything including automatic import.
Prop Firm and Evaluation Support
This is the most significant functional difference between the two tools.
Edgewonk: Not Built for Evaluations

Edgewonk is a general trading analytics platform. It has no concept of 'evaluation account' vs. 'live funded account.' You can't configure a Max Daily Loss, trailing drawdown, or Profit Target that gets monitored in the dashboard. Traders in evaluations use Edgewonk manually, with no native integration of their prop firm's specific rules.
Zentrade: Built for Evaluations from Day 1

Zentrade has Evaluation and Live account types built into the design. When you create an evaluation account, you configure the Max Daily Loss, Max Drawdown, and Profit Target for your specific firm — and the dashboard monitors them automatically. FTMO's Consistency Rule is calculated in real time. The calendar shows which days you approached or violated a rule and why.
Statistical Analysis Depth: Where Edgewonk Still Wins

Edgewonk has 10+ years of development and offers extremely deep statistical analysis: Monte Carlo simulations, confirmation bias analysis, R-multiple optimization, performance breakdown by time of day, and dozens of advanced metrics. For a trader who wants to explore deep system statistics, Edgewonk remains the reference.

Zentrade prioritizes the metrics that matter most for funded account evaluations: daily P&L, consistency %, profit factor, win rate by instrument and session, and real-time risk alerts. If your primary goal is passing prop firm evaluations and keeping funded accounts, Zentrade covers everything needed and presents it more clearly.
AI Analysis: Zentrade's Exclusive Advantage
Zentrade's ZenMode plan includes AI-powered features that Edgewonk doesn't offer:

items: Weekly AI Report (Gemini): every Monday you receive an analysis of your trading week including emotion patterns, best-performing hours, and specific recommendations for the following week
Revenge Trading Detection: automatically flags when you entered an aggressive trade after a losing streak — the most common pattern that destroys evaluations
Real-time Risk Alerts: when you approach 80% of your Daily Loss limit or your Consistency % nears the threshold, you get an alert before it's too late
Market Preview (Sundays): weekly email with the top 4-6 high-impact market events for the coming week, tailored to your instruments

items.q: Can I migrate my trades from Edgewonk to Zentrade?
items.a: Yes. If you export your trades from Edgewonk as CSV, you can import them into Zentrade using the CSV import feature (Professional plan). The column mapping is flexible and can be adapted to Edgewonk's export format.

items.q: Does Edgewonk have a free version?
items.a: No. Edgewonk offers a limited trial, but there's no permanent free plan. Once the trial ends, you need to purchase a license to continue using it.

items.q: Does Zentrade work for stock traders, not just futures?
items.a: Zentrade is optimized primarily for CME futures (NQ, MNQ, ES, GC, CL, and similar contracts). The P&L calculation system uses tick size and tick value for futures contracts. For pure stock or Forex traders, some futures-specific metrics may not apply directly.

items.q: Does Edgewonk track the FTMO Consistency Rule automatically?
items.a: No, not natively. You can manually calculate the consistency rule using Edgewonk's data, but there's no automatic indicator that monitors the percentage of your best day vs. total gains in real time. Zentrade calculates this automatically on the dashboard.

items.q: Is Zentrade only for prop firm traders?
items.a: No. Zentrade works for any futures trader who wants to track their performance, whether you're in an evaluation, trading a personal account, or managing multiple accounts across different firms. The prop firm evaluation features are an additional layer on top of the core trading journal.
